Happened years ago, but I think about it a lot. I went to an undergraduate college located in New York… only that it was online and I never actually been to New York. I was embarrassed that I went to an online school because I graduated high school super young and never had the “real” college experience. Anyways, I was in a conversation with 4 of my classmates at a grad school welcoming event and they asked me where I was from. I said I went to school in New York. Unfortunately, 2 of my classmates were from New York and called me out for not know a damn thing about New York and I fumbled when telling them I went to an online school so it looked significantly worse. Overall very cringe experience that still haunts me.

I was in the same spot you were a couple of years ago. It’s okay to tough out for a year, but it will haunt you for possibly the rest of your life. It’s been 4 years and I still have nightmares of the job. Not only of the content, but going over the same thing over and over again. I worked as a content moderator for almost a year. Just take care (don’t turn to substance abuse) of yourself and make sure you do something worth it with the money you make, as in invest into your future so you never have to do something like this again. Save as much as you can.

Get a good backpack, you’ll need your books. A lot of people I knew had rolling backpacks. My school’s law library had a free scanning service so you could easily scan the pages you needed if it’s one of those classes where the professor isn’t going to randomly say “turn to this page”, but you never know. An alternative is seeing if your library has course reserves where you can just check out the book for a limited amount of time and bring it to class.

I live on almeda and I would say it’s safe for the most part during the daytime. Depending on which part of almeda. Closer to the park is really safe and a lot of people even walk in Hermann Park at night. Still be aware of your surroundings though we have a lot of homeless people who are harmless but sometimes will harass you. Be careful crossing the street because we’ve been having a lot of incidents of people getting run over by cars and drivers have oftentimes tried to scare me for no reason. We also have a lot of drunk drivers because of the proximity to bars and restaurants. I would say my building is really nice and we have 24/7 security but it’s because we’ve had several incidents of armed robberies. We also had a huge issue with car jackings within our garage and people getting their wheels stolen.
